title: The Grinchy Poo
description: Old Grinchy Poo plans to steal Christmas from all the Poos in Pooville, but has a change of heart after being befriended by Cindy Lou Poo.
quote: Why are you taking our Christmas tree, why?
altHero: Grinchy Poo trying to get a Christmas tree up the chimney
alt1: Cindy Lou Poo holding a Christmas ornament
alt3: the Poos in Pooville dancing in a circle
alt4: Grinchy Poo cutting a Christmas roast next to two kid Poos
